title: COMMAND THE NEW DAY FOR SUPERNATURAL BREAKTHROUGHS | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: Every new day is an invitation from God to begin again. Fresh grace, fresh favor, fresh help. Psalm 118:4 declares, "This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it." That means the day was not manufactured by men. It was crafted by the wisdom of God and delivered into your hands. So lift your voice right now and say, "Father, I receive this day as a gift. I receive it as a weapon of victory. I receive it as a platform of manifestation." Beloved, hear me. Days are not neutral.

Every day carries an atmosphere, a voice, a script. Job 382 says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the daypring to know his place? If you do not command the day, someone else will. If you don't speak to the gates, the gates will speak to you." So this morning, we take our priestly position and we legislate by light. Say after me, "Oh morning, hear the word of the Lord. My path is favored. My steps are ordered. My hands are blessed and my destiny advances without delay.

Father, we stand as ambassadors of the kingdom and we decree that the sun will not smite us by day, nor the moon by night. We command the heavens to favor us, the earth to yield to us, and the elements to cooperate with our destiny. Psalm 19 verse1 the heavens declare the glory of God. Therefore the heavens over you will declare your success. Now Father by your spirit let every limitation from yesterday be buried. Let every mistake find redemption in mercy. Let every regret become revelation.

Lamentations 3 22 to 23. It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed. They are new every morning. That mercy has arrived again. Yesterday's failures are not allowed to follow into today's agenda. Declare this with confidence by the mercies of God. I start this day free from guilt, free from fear, and full of faith. By the power of the Holy Ghost, I walk into divine opportunities. By the word of the Lord, I command the new day to align with prophecy. Beloved, the morning is the womb of the day.

What you sew into it determines what it births by evening. That is why Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." This is not routine, is government. Every decree is legislation. Every confession is a verdict in the spirit. Now begin to bless your atmosphere. Father, I command peace into my home, favor into my work, wisdom into my decisions, joy into my heart.

I command strength into my body, ideas into my mind, and helpers into my path. Let every plan of hell designed for this day scatter before dawn. Psalm 68:1. Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. So Lord, arise over this new day. Arise over my family, my city, my destiny. Let your enemies be scattered and let your favor rest like dew. Thus saith the spirit of God, you are stepping into hours that carry miracles. Every time period of this day is pregnant with possibility. Heaven's schedule has your name on it.

Expect calls you didn't dial, doors you didn't knock, results you didn't labor for. For Amos 9:3 says, "Behold, the days come, sayeth the Lord, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper." That means acceleration is released. Time collapses for your sake. Lift your right hand and decree, "By the spirit of acceleration, I overtake delay. By divine speed, I recover lost time. By divine favor I step into prepared blessings. This new day will yield increase. This new day will deliver results.

Father we consecrate this morning as holy ground. No gossip, no distraction, no frustration will hijack the peace of this day. will set it apart for productivity, for revelation, for laughter, for fruitfulness. Genesis 1: es 5. And God called the light day, and the darkness he called night. You are called day, not darkness. Therefore, darkness is forbidden to operate in you. I speak over your steps. Everywhere you go today, the fragrance of favor will announce you. Psalm 84:11. For the Lord God is a son and shield.

The Lord will give grace and glory. No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly. Grace and glory travel with you like twin companions. Beloved, this is the power of prophetic mornings. When men are still asleep, kings legislate. When others wait for luck, the righteous create order. You will not stumble into success, you will command it. Psalm 2:8. Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance. Ask boldly this morning.

Ask for the nation of your influence, the territory of your assignment, the resources for your vision. Father, I ask for supernatural breakthroughs. Let limitations crumble. Let results overflow. Let everything you've written for this day find manifestation. Let favor locate the one who believes. Let the heavens bear witness that this is the day of divine surprise. Now declare it. By the power of divine alignment, my day is fruitful. Every second carries advantage. Every encounter carries increase.

Every word I speak carries weight. This day will not betray my destiny. It will serve it. Father, we thank you for answered prayer. The heavens have heard. The earth will respond and testimonies will multiply. Psalm 65:11. Thou crownest the year with thy goodness and thy parts fatness. even this day will drip with goodness. As we go forth, we do so in power, clothed with light and with wisdom and shielded by grace.

So we command this new day become the highway of miracles, the carrier of laughter, the stage for divine manifestation. And we decree this day is blessed. This day is fruitful. This day is victorious. This day is for the glory of God. Amen. Lift your voice wherever you are and give thanks to the Lord who has brought you into the dawn of power. Say, "Father, thank you because this is my morning of victory, my morning of freedom, my morning of divine establishment." Psalm 46:5, God is in the midst of her.

She shall not be moved. God shall help her and that right early. That means help is not delayed. It is timely. The new day carries help you have prayed for. Now decree aloud this morning. Help locates me. This morning favor finds me this morning. Destiny doors open before me. Every closed gate of opportunity swings wide at my command. Isaiah 45:2, I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. Father, go before us into every meeting, every assignment, every decision. Straighten the path of destiny.

Let the crooked be made plain. Let the rough places be made smooth. Beloved, every day has gates. Psalm 24:7, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lift up ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in. You do not enter days casually. You enter two gates." So, Father, we stand at the gate of this day and we decree, LIFT UP YOUR HEADS, OH YE GATES OF LIMITATION. LIFT UP YOUR HEADS, OH YE GATES OF RESISTANCE. Let the King of glory COME INTO US, STRONG IN BATTLE, MIGHTY to save, mighty to deliver.

Say aloud, I decree and declare, EVERY GATE THAT RESISTED me yesterday opens at the sound OF FAITH TODAY. NO EVIL watcher can shut what grace has opened. THE GATES OF SUCCESS, HONOR, AND BREAKTHROUGH are lifted. Now, Father, we address the altars of delay and stagnation. Isaiah 61:7, "For your shame ye shall have double, and for confusion, they shall rejoice in their portion. Every altar that kept men cackling one mountain will break its hold.

Every voice that says not yet, when heaven says now, be silenced, we decrease speed where there was delay, settlement where there was struggle. Declare, by the power of divine acceleration, I move from prophecy to performance. By divine mercy, I recover lost time. By divine favor, I overtake those ahead of me. Psalm 18:29, "For by thee I have run to a troop, and by my God have I leaked over a wall. Walls fall before worshippers. Obstacles become stepping stones. Leap again. The hand of the Lord is your advantage.

Father, let the voice of deliverance sound." Psalm 32:7, "Thou art at my hiding place. Thou shalt preserve me from trouble. Thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Every trouble planned for this day dissolves at your presence. Every ambush collapses. Every evil council returns to confusion. The atmosphere is cleared for breakthrough. Now decree it with conviction. By the blood of Jesus, I am free from every invisible chain. By the mercy of God, I am lifted above every accusation.

By the spirit of God, I walk in liberty and dominion. Galatians 5:1. STAND FAST, THEREFORE, in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free. Freedom is not a dream. It is a reality you enforce every morning. Father, we now command breakthrough in work, business, and calling. Deuteronomy 28 12, the Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand. Open your good treasure, oh God. Let ideas flow like rivers.

Opportunities spring up like wells and favor rain on every effort. Say aloud, "The work of my hands is blessed. The fruit of my mind is productive. The labor of my life yields profit. Every investment, every plan, every project prospers. Psalm 1:3, "Whatsoever he doeth shall prosper, not some whatsoever." Prosperity becomes the signature of obedience. Beloved, there are unseen battles that rise with the dawn, but the covenant is older than the conflict. Exodus 14:14.

The Lord shall fight for you and ye shall hold your peace. So Lord, fight for your people today. Let angelic reinforcements surround them like mountains surround Jerusalem. Psalm 125:2. As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people. Round about every side secured. We decree there will be no loss, no accident, no negative surprise. Lift both hands and proclaim, "I am preserved on every side. My journey is protected. My going out is blessed. My coming in is blessed.

Every road I take is cleared by angels." Psalm 91:11, he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. That charge is active again today. Father, now we speak the language of breakthrough in health. Jeremiah 30:17. For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds. Restore strength to weary bodies, heal every cell, every organ, every system. Let the energy of resurrection quicken mortal bodies. Romans 8 11.

The spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies. Let vitality replace fatigue. Let joy replace heaviness. Let peace replace anxiety. Declare, "My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. Sickness cannot dwell here. My mind is renewed by the word. Confusion cannot stay here. My heart is guarded by peace. Fear cannot leave here." And now, Father, command breakthroughs of influence. Psalm 75 6-7.

For promotion cometh neither from the east nor from the west, nor from the south, but God is the judge. Raise men and women from obscurity. Let favor move files, shift policies, and rewrite outcomes. Let forgotten names be remembered today. Let divine remembrance open doors of appointment and endorsement. Say, I am remembered for good. I am lifted by grace. I am distinguished by excellence. I am celebrated by mercy. Daniel 2 21. He changed the times and the seasons. He removeth kings and setth up kings.

Season change now. the tables turn in your favor. Father, thank you for supernatural breakthroughs already set in motion. Thank you because this day is sealed with victory. Psalm 118:23. This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. Let marvels fill our hours. Let testimonies surprise us before sunset. So we decree together, this is my day of manifestation. This is my day of supernatural breakthrough. The heavens respond to my faith. The earth yields to my command and all things work together for my good.

Romans 8 31. If God be for us, who can be against us? God is for you. Therefore, nothing succeeds against you. Amen. Father, thank you for your faithfulness in my family, my destiny, and everything that concerns me. Psalm 138:8, the Lord will perfect that which concernth me. That means no aspect of your life will be left unfinished. God does not begin what he will not complete. This day he perfects the details that have been hanging in transition. Now decree aloud. By divine perfection, my destiny takes shape.

By divine order, my family works in peace. By divine grace, my restoration begins. Now beloved, every destiny carries a pattern. But every pattern can be interrupted by warfare. There are people whose lives seem to replay the same frustration every season, but today we bring that cycle to an end. Ecclesiastes 3:14, "Whatsoever God doeth, it shall be forever." That means restoration from God is irreversible. When he restores, the enemy cannot rest. Father, we stand in the authority of redemption and decree.

Every destiny trapped in delay is released. Every vision buried in fear rises again. Every purpose hidden under confusion emerges by light. Isaiah 60:1, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come." And the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee. The light of a new day commands the rising of new stars. This is the hour for your unveiling. Say it boldly. I arise by revelation. I shine by grace. I manifest by the spirit. This day will advertise the glory of God in my life. Now, Father, we present families before your throne.

Psalm 112: es 2, his seed shall be mighty upon earth. Let might be the testimony of every child, every generation. Let no bloodline continue in affliction. We cancel generational patterns of failure, early death and division. We invoke the blood that speaks better things. Hebrews 12:4 to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better things than that of Abel. Let that blood speak preservation, provision, and peace. Decree it now. My family is redeemed.

My lineage is cleansed. My home is preserved. My seed is mighty upon the earth. Beloved, many families carry invisible altars, cycles that repeat, voices that accuse, but this morning we legislate deliverance. Colossians 2:15. And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shoe of them openly. The cross was a public display of defeat to darkness. Therefore, Father, we invoke the finished work. Let every contrary altar crumble. Let every voice of accusation be silenced.

Let every projection against peace return void. Let angels of deliverance stand at the gates of every family represented here. Declare this with authority. By the victory of the cross, my family is fireproof. By the resurrection of Jesus, our covenant is unbreakable. By the MERCY OF GOD, OUR generations are blessed. Psalm 91:10. There shall no evil befall thee. Neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling. That is your household insurance signed in blood guaranteed by grace. Now, Father, restore wasted years.

Joel 2 25 I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten. Time may have been lost but grace redeems time. Let years wasted in confusion return as wisdom. Let years wasted in sickness return as health. Let years WASTED IN FINANCIAL STRUGGLE RETURN AS ABUNDANCE. LET EVERY opportunity once lost be REPLACED BY SEVEN BETTER ONES. DECREED WITH FAITH. BY THE MERCY of restoration, my life advances beyond delay. BY THE COVENANT OF GRACE, I recover WHAT WAS STOLEN.

BY THE AUTHORITY OF CHRIST, I ENTER new seasons of speed and settlement. Psalm 126: es 1-2. When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream. Then was our mouth filled with laughter. Get ready for laughter. Your story will sound like exaggeration. What you thought was lost forever will reappear in glory. Father, we now speak to finances because breakthrough without provision is incomplete. Hagi 2:8, "The silver is mine and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts.

Resources answer to the voice of the redeemed. We command open heavens over labor, ideas, and enterprise. Let debt dissolve. Let bills be paid. Let contracts be approved. Let channels of supply be multiplied." Psalm 23:1, "The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. From this day, lack becomes illegal. Want becomes a stranger. Grace becomes your new economy." Now say prophetically, "By divine supply, I lack nothing. By divine favor, I attract abundance. By divine wisdom, I manage increase.

By divine mercy I overflow with joy. Proverbs 10 22. The blessing of the Lord it maketh rich and he addeth no sorrow with it. Sorrow is not part of the blessing package. Therefore wealth will not bring worry. It will sponsor worship. And now father we speak stability into relationships and homes.

Ephesians 4:3, "Endeavoring to keep the unity of the spirit in the bond of peace, let love return to marriages, understanding return to friendships, honor return to partnerships, let forgiveness replace bitterness, and communication replace silence. Let kingdom order rule hearts again. We cancel satanic interference in emotional bonds. We speak peace into marriages, engagements, and ministries. Say aloud, "The peace of God reigns in my home. The wisdom of God guides my choices. The mercy OF GOD SHIELDS MY HEART.

THE JOY OF THE LORD is my atmosphere. Father, we decree that the sun will not smite us by day, nor the moon by night. Psalm 121:5-6. The Lord is thy keeper. The Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand. The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night. Preserve your people from accidents, from sudden attacks, from unseen conspiracies. Let the canopy of your presence hover over every journey. No evil report, no bad news, no negative surprise. Let testimonies arise instead.

And we declare this day is sealed with light. This day is drenched in favor. This day is loaded with mercy. Every second of this day delivers progress. Psalm 68:1 19. Blessed be the Lord who daily loaded us with benefits. Receive your daily load, not of problems but of blessings. Now lift your voice in gratitude. Say, Father, thank you because the power of restoration is working in my life. Thank you because my family is free, my destiny is advancing, and my story is changing. Psalm 103:2 to5.

Bless the Lord, oh my soul, and forget not all his benefits. Who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases. Who redeemth thy life from destruction, who crowneth thee with loving kindness and tender mercies, who satisfyth thy mount with good things, so that thy youth is renewed like the eagles. Be renewed, be restored, be revived, be rewarded, and let the morning carry your shout of victory. This is my day of supernatural breakthroughs. Everything connected to me flourishes. I am blessed.

I am favored. I am unstoppable. Amen. Lift your hands wherever you are and thank him again for the victories already unfolding. Say, "Father, I honor you for the miracles I can already sense. I give you praise because the gates of this day are open and my results are certain. Psalm 9:1 I will praise thee, oh Lord, with my whole heart. I will show forth all thy marvelous works. Thanksgiving is the password to continual triumph. When gratitude rises, power flows.

Father, as we seal this day, let every prophecy become performance. Luke 1:45, "Blessed is she that believed, for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord. No more delay, no more pending promises. This morning's decrees become today's testimonies. Now decree it with strength. By the covenant of the spoken word, every declaration I have made stands established. By divine backing, my words carry creative power. By faith, I legislate dominion over this new day. Genesis 1:3.

And God said, let there be light. And there was light. Light answers to speech. Every word you've spoken today summons light into existence. Let there be light in your decisions, your appointments, your transactions, your journeys. Let every shadow of confusion flee before your voice. Thus, saith the spirit of God, I am causing quick turnarounds. I am raising helpers from unexpected quarters. I am silencing the voice of the accuser that followed you from night into day. Isaiah 43 18 to19.

Remember ye not the former things. Neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. The new thing is not approaching. It has begun. Miracles that once took months will now emerge in hours. Phone calls, approvals, reconciliations, and breakthroughs will confirm this word. Say aloud, "Father, I receive the new thing. I step into fresh oil, fresh wisdom, fresh opportunities. Father, we release the mantle of preservation over every listener."

Psalm 125:1, "They that trust in the Lord shall be as Mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth forever. Let stability be the testimony of your people. They will not be moved by wind or whisper." Faith replaces fear. Strength replaces struggle. Every heart receives endurance. Every mind receives clarity. Let the peace that passes understanding become their environment. Now decree it. My mind is sound. My faith is firm. My focus is fixed. My heart is steadfast. Father, we declare supernatural favor.

Psalm 102:13. Thou shalt arise and have mercy upon Zion for the time to favor her. Yay, the set time is come. This is that set time. Favor compresses seasons. Favor cancels protocols. Favor rewrites policies. Let it rest on every person under the sound of this prayer. Let men remember them for good. Let systems respond to their presence. Let rejection TURN INTO RECOMMENDATION. SAY WITH CONVICTION, "By divine favor, I sit among kings. By divine favor, I RECEIVE ACCEPTANCE.

BY DIVINE FAVOR, I ATTRACT RESOURCES AND RESULTS." BELOVED, victory must be sealed in worship. Psalm 149:6, "Let the high praises of God be in their mouth and a two-edged sword in their hand. Praise is both weapon and weakness." Lift your voice now in adoration. Father, you reign forever. You are my confidence, my fortress, my song in the morning. As your worship rises, burdens lift, atmospheres change, and angelic activity intensifies around you. Now hear this final decree.

By the spirit of dominion, I go forth as light that cannot be hidden. By the blood of the everlasting covenant, I am sealed from harm. By the wisdom of God, I make sound decisions. By divine strength I accomplish everything assigned for this day. Deuteronomy 33 25. As thy days, so shall thy strength be. Your strength will match every assignment. There will be no collapse at noon, no frustration at dusk. Grace will last till the day is dawn and joy will greet the evening. Now lift your hands for the closing seal.

Father, I thank you because the heavens are open, the earth is fruitful, and my life is evidence of your goodness. Thank you because this day is commanded not guest, directed, not drifted. Thank you because I am covered in fire, filled with wisdom, and surrounded by mercy. Psalm 65:11, "Thou crownest the year with thy goodness, and thy parts drop fatness. Even this day wears a crown of goodness. Every hour will drip with favor. Every step will echo with testimony.

Now, Father, let your people go forth as ambassadors of light. Let everything that sees them recognize the mark of grace. Let their words carry weight. Let their results draw men to Christ. And together we seal it with thanksgiving. Unto him who is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think. To him be glory forever. Amen. Amen. And amen.
